launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Jai & Aditya - co-founders of Sero.

## TL;DR

Sero is an all-in-one platform purpose-built for B2B **implementation & professional services teams**. Our AI agents help you launch customers faster, more consistently and more efficiently.

<https://youtu.be/kulvgzcllcs>

## ❌ The problem

Before Sero, we built a workflow automation platform for customer success teams. Our main learning: **\~40% of customer churn is caused by poor implementations.** Yet, implementation is still the most broken function in the B2B SaaS GTM stack. And it’s getting worse:

* AI-native platforms are rapidly replacing legacy enterprise software → the # of implementations is exploding
* AI agent deployments require deep collaboration with customers → implementations need to be customer facing
* Every company is shipping features faster → implementations are getting more complex

## 👁️ What it looks like today

While sales has a CRM, support has a helpdesk and customer success has a CSP, implementation teams are still onboarding customers using generic project management tools and spreadsheets that are siloed. The result?

* Onboarding processes aren’t repeatable
* Customers don’t know where implementations stand
* Teams are spending 6+ hours a week manually chasing customers
* Go-live delays are getting caught too late

**As companies scale, teams are spread thin, implementation quality drops further, and churn increases rapidly.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99567&key=user_uploads/737853/5992809d-3af3-4c53-92c7-1b6a53efe640)


## 💡 How Sero fixes this

Sero is the **system-of-action** for implementation teams, supercharged by agents:

* **Project Execution**: Adaptive templates turn customer requirements into tailored project plans, so every implementation starts perfectly. Agents keep tasks on track and flag at-risk projects before it's too late.
* **Customer Collaboration**: A branded customer portal replaces messy email threads. Our accountability agent chases customers for you, so nothing stalls.
* **Resourcing & Utilization**: Forecast team capacity against future demand to stay ahead of staffing gaps. AI categorization makes time tracking instant.

The result: Sero makes implementation a competitive advantage - accelerating time-to-value, delighting customers, and driving retention.

## 🙏🏻 Our ask

Sero is growing fast. Two ways you can help:

* **If you're scaling and feeling the pain of implementations,** whether it's go-live delays, chasing customers, or inconsistent onboarding, let’s chat! You can book a call here: <https://cal.com/jai-thirani-xcyalr/sero-demo>.
* **If you know any implementation, onboarding or professional services leaders** — we'd really appreciate an intro. You can email me at [jai@sero.so](mailto:jai@sero.so) with their details and I’ll send across an email that’s easy to forward!
